revision_reason: R01 was blocked before authorization because analyzer identity, actual trace equality, authorized-row identity and zero-rate gates were incomplete; subsequent R02 rereviews additionally required remote serial enforcement and predecessor deployment binding. R02 closes these governance gaps while preserving the same two-cell bandwidth intervention without expanding the scientific claim scope.
objective: Authorize and execute the reviewed 500 MHz versus 50 MHz ISL RF bandwidth sensitivity pair, then recompute the preregistered horizon-aggregate directed-ISL link-utilization contrast from verified receipts.
context: This is a one-seed engineering sensitivity diagnosis, not an algorithm comparison or paper-facing effect estimate.
Both cells share trace seed, trace identity, deterministic hop routing, topology, access, demand and stopping contract; the only declared intervention is links.rf_isl.bandwidth_hz.
Bandwidth changes noise, SNR, discrete MCS selection, data service time and control service time; it is not a pure capacity multiplier.

The primary metric isl_link_utilization_max is the maximum across directed ISL links after each link aggregates served_bits divided by sampled available_capacity_bits over the full run horizon; it is not a one-second-window maximum.
The numerator records successful DataPacket service only; control packets are reported separately and can reduce data service through shared-link contention, but are not counted as data served_bits.

The matrix declares execution_policy.mode=serial_fail_closed; the local launcher applies an early gate before SSH and the deployed remote prepare/run paths independently reapply the gate before any later child starts, using canonical nonce-bound VM witnesses.

Acceptance fields are zero/false and do not filter unfavorable outcomes. Validity instead requires exact identity binding, clean-main deployment, natural end, conservation, governance receipt, external witness and analyzer-commit binding.
The existing 25M/50M E0VIS17 runs are research_eligible=false diagnostics with different trace hashes and must not be pooled with this pair.

Revision 1 was blocked before authorization by adversarial and Kimi reviews because analyzer identity, actual cross-cell trace equality, authorized-row identity and zero-rate gates were incomplete; pre-fix-review-history.json preserves those findings.
excluded_inputs: Any dynamically edited or locally launched simulation config
deliverables: A schema-valid three-role review and finalization bound to the exact two-cell matrix and analyzer implementation
One generated authorization bound to the finalization and exact compiled artifacts
Receipt-verified natural-end VM outputs for b500-s7 and b50-s7 on one clean deployed main SHA
A persisted V2 paired analysis for isl_link_utilization_max with raw receipt and ledger provenance
cannot_claim: A causal information-value or routing-policy effect
A universal low, onset or pressure threshold
Paper-ready statistical evidence from one seed
Any conclusion that silently excludes a failed or unfavorable arm
acceptance: The exact revision-2 matrix, analyzer semantics, pre-fix review history and this brief pass independent cold-start, satellite-DRL and adversarial review with no unresolved blocker.

Both cells are launched only through the canonical remote runner from the same clean main deployment and complete naturally with conservation, governance identity, canonical governance payload hash and external witness checks passing; a predecessor from another commit, tree, deployment receipt or execution chain is rejected.
The two actual trace_sha256 values match; a mismatch invalidates the paired interpretation even if trace_identity_sha256 was equal before execution.

The b50 cell is machine-blocked both before SSH and again at the deployed remote prepare/run boundary unless b500 has first completed naturally and its receipt, conservation, governance eligibility, nonce-bound external witness, identity, primary ISL metric and mcs_zero_rate_holds=0 checks all pass; any failure stops the cohort.

Receipt verification recomputes congestion metrics from raw event ledgers; V2 analysis consumes the verified metrics, persists VERIFIED artifacts, and binds the analyzer's exact Git commit plus v2_analysis.py and metrics.py hashes; no one-second-window or paper-facing claim is inferred.
Any zero-rate hold, interruption, event-limit stop, missing ISL link metrics, receipt mismatch or governance_receipt.research_eligible != true stops analysis rather than being silently excluded.

The persisted analysis separately reports MCS rate diagnostics, control counters, per-directed-ISL served_bits and sampled available_capacity_bits, and saturated-link identifiers; a zero contrast with saturation cannot be interpreted as no bandwidth sensitivity.
